python3 -B - <<'PY'
import http.client,json,sys
new="84a880150a72bfc4b05559d22c58027f5eeb9feb"
previous="3fa459f9216471f285411a183894bdbc3bb4830f"
con=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
try:
 con.request("GET","/healthz")
 res=con.getresponse()
 data=json.loads(res.read(10000)) if res.status==200 else {}
finally:con.close()
live=data.get("commit")
if live==new:
 print("LIVE_NEW_SHA=PASS")
 sys.exit(0)
if live==previous:
 print("LIVE_PREVIOUS_SHA=PASS")
 sys.exit(64)
print("LIVE_SHA_UNEXPECTED")
sys.exit(65)
PY
